input-external-editor-key.reason: The external editor. In the recorder the original's editor launch fails on the fake TUI (`tui.stop is not a function`, the recorder cannot stop a terminal it does not own), so the notification carries that message. The Go port cannot stop the host's TUI (SDK lacks tui.stop/start) and reports its own refusal text (editInput in questionnaire.go). The draft is kept in both: every frame is identical.

diffs.golden: "[{\"message\":\"External editor failed: tui.stop is not a function\",\"level\":\"error\"}]"
diffs.go: "[{\"message\":\"External editor failed: @pi-in-go/pigpen-ask-user-question (Go port) does not support the external editor for custom answers yet. Install the original extension, npm:@juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question@2.11.0, which runs unchanged in PiG.\",\"level\":\"error\"}]"

keybindings-external-editor-remap.reason: Same as input-external-editor-key, with app.editor.external remapped to ctrl+q: the key routes identically, only the notification text differs.

preview-code-fence-languages.reason: Pi colours a fenced code block whose language highlight.js knows through cli-highlight (syntaxKeyword, syntaxString, ... tokens); the Go port does not highlight (internal/ui/markdown_theme.go, deviation recorded there: every code line goes through the mdCodeBlock colour, as pi does for a block without a valid language). The ```text fence is identical in both. Only the lines inside ts/go/json fences differ.
